description: LayerNorm A/B of the champion exp010 (E=384 dual-stream HyperplaneMHL, best_val_bpb 1.1940). EXACTLY ONE change vs exp010: the three MeanAbsNorm(E) pre-norms (ln_pre, ln_resid, ln_emb_resid) are replaced by nn.LayerNorm(E) with standard affine (done in train.py; ln_final was already LayerNorm and is unchanged). Everything else byte-identical to exp010: E=D=384, 6 layers, 6 heads x d_qk=d_v=64, ctx 512, vocab 32768, RoPE 1e4, untied embeddings, dual-stream (E-stream attention + D-stream residual via residual_lut/emb_resid_lut), LUT sites qk nap4/tph256, v nap6/tph256, out_proj nap7/tph512, residual nap6/tph256, emb_resid nap6/tph256 (HyperplaneMHL, hard, anchor_pairs), 16000 steps, 24576 tokens/step, Lion lut_lr 2e-4 / AdamW adam_lr 3e-4 (hyperplanes no-wd, unembed wd0.1), grad clip 1.0, warmup 0.1 cosine, bf16 tables + fp32 master. Tests whether standard LayerNorm beats the MeanAbsNorm the champion used. Baseline: exp010 best_val_bpb 1.1940 @ 324.7M / 3.537h. LayerNorm adds only tiny affine params so total ~= exp010's 324.7M.
